VA.grade_reason: The ArcGIS well layers are free, no login and answered from here, one record per well, but they hold only a status date (FiStatDt), a drilling-complete date and a well-completion date, not a labeled permit issue date, and a well leaves the 'undrilled' layer once drilled. VA.producer_plan: Option 1, history: query layer 0 (Active Wells) in pages of 2000 and count FiDrComp (drilling complete) and FiWellComp (well completion) by month, split by TblOpDesc; this measures wells drilled or completed, like New Mexico's spuds, with a lag. Option 2, permits going forward: query layer 4 (Permitted Undrilled Wells) and layer 1 (Pending Wells) every night and keep a log of each FiNo with its TblPsDesc and FiStatDt; the first night a FiNo appears with TblPsDesc 'Issued' and its FiStatDt gives an approximate issue month, and Pending Wells gives applications waiting. Wells leave layer 4 when drilled, so history cannot be rebuilt from it. Check whether FiStatDt on an 'Issued' row is the issue date (many fall on the same day in pairs and threes, which looks like batches, but this is not confirmed). Option 3: the DGO Inquiry 'Permit Issuance' and 'Permit Issuance Statistics' reports, if they give issue dates; they need an ASP.NET form post, which is fragile. The VGOB service is not started. Work type is not a field (new vs modification is separate layers: Pending Wells vs Pending Well Modifications).
